Package ro.sync.ecss.extensions.api.link

Interface ElementLocatorProvider

All Superinterfaces:
Extension
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultElementLocatorProvider, DITAElementLocatorProvider, XHTMLElementLocatorProvider
@API(type=EXTENDABLE, src=PUBLIC) public interface ElementLocatorProvider extends Extension
This class is able to provide an implementation of an ElementLocator based on the structure of a link. The ElementLocator is capable of locating an element pointed by the supplied link.
